text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-79/review.md
+# Independent visual QA — issue #79
+
+**Issue:** [Present and download the exact authorized result generation safely](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/79). **Reviewer:** GPT-6.1 Sol, High reasoning. **Review date:** 2026-10-25. **Verdict:** changes warranted; **1 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 1 LOW**. Review only; this report changes neither acceptance nor issue state.
+
+The important identity behavior worked in the exercised fixture journey: a failed version-1 download remained retryable after Watch new selected version 2, and the next ordinary download selected version 2. However, first playback-access failure has no recovery UI, replacement progress fails to identify the previous player, and a Russian reconciliation action breaks phone reflow. Compact desktop actions also merit reconsideration as a requirement, despite matching the selected density.
+
+## Snapshot, method and evidence boundary
+
+HEAD was `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`; there were no tracked frontend differences. The repository already contained unrelated dirty documentation, skills and evidence. [boundary.json](boundary.json) records the exact dirty paths and SHA-256 fingerprints of the issue snapshot, active flow, tokens, adoption and reviewed source. Only this `issue-79` directory was written. No product/spec changes, full-suite run, Git/GitHub mutation, physical microphone, speakers or production integration occurred.
+
+Command: from repository root, `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-79/capture.cjs`, with isolated Vite `npm.cmd run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4379 --strictPort` from `frontend`. Windows, installed Playwright Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, headless, DPR 1, default zoom, muted audio and fake-device/fake-UI flags. Final capture command exited 0 with zero page errors and all recorded interaction assertions passing. [Capture script](capture.cjs), [capture log](capture.log), [raw metrics](metrics.json), [24-image manifest](screenshot-manifest.json).
+
+**These are fresh seeded component fixtures, not a native end-to-end owner journey.** Existing `frontend/e2e/harness/result.html` and `result-delivery-state.html` mount the actual ResultScreen and actual CSS inside `app-main`, without the full global/project shell. The capture script intercepts only the served controlled-fixture module to select EN/RU or return replacement, unavailable, first-descriptor-error and unknown-download service states. It does not change ResultScreen, controls or CSS. Existing controlled fixture APIs publish generation 2 and resolve the first download as a failure. Delivery-state fixtures supply trusted/untrusted percentages, assembly failure and a deliberately broken media URL. Synthetic fixed MP4s are explicitly labeled in the UI; none was rendered from a user upload or accepted recordings. The sample project title remains fixture English in RU captures. Browser download events and suggested filenames are evidence of request delivery, not completed OS saving or production asset authorization.
+
+All screenshots embedded in findings below were opened with `view_image` and visually inspected. Additional matrix images were inspected where used for comparison. Some paused fixture screenshots include Chromium's native loading indicator; no finding is inferred from that transient indicator. Measurements were collected after `document.fonts.ready`; Mabry Pro 400 and 500 reported loaded, controls computed Mabry Pro 500, and body/video inherited Mabry Pro 400. This is browser font evidence, not an independent font-file authenticity audit.
+
+## Task purpose and acceptance coverage
+
+Screen question: **Is my dubbed video ready, and which version will I watch or download?** The owner needs to review the finished media, continue using a safe previous result during replacement, switch deliberately, download the displayed version, and recover without reassembly or extra charges. The largest object should answer that question while status and recovery remain easy to act on.
+
+| Contract | Expected | Fresh actual evidence | Assessment |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| AC-01 authorization/eligibility | Only authorized exact nonempty snapshots assemble; reload reuses identity | Result fixture consumes a finished/active context; real producer/eligibility/reload races not exercised | Evidence gap; no new acceptance claim |
+| AC-02 progress | Unknown: message only; trusted: one 4px bar and service percentage; no ETA/cancel | [unknown EN](evidence/assembly-unknown-en-desktop.png), [trusted 42% RU phone](evidence/assembly-known-ru-phone.png): correct message/bar distinction | Bounded pass for progress; principal-stage layout mismatch QA-79-07 |
+| AC-03 failure/previous preservation | Prior remains usable; one automatic retry then manual fallback | [assembly failure RU short](evidence/assembly-failed-ru-short.png) exposes Repeat assembly. Retry budget, stale completion/deletion and persisted lineage not rerun | Partial; no claim about durable retry policy |
+| AC-04 replacement presentation | Old playing media stays old; Previous version; Watch new selects new at start paused | [new-ready RU phone](evidence/new-ready-ru-phone.png), [switched version 2](evidence/new-displayed-old-download-error-en-desktop.png); script asserts paused/time 0 and old/new source IDs | Bounded switch pass; missing previous label while assembling QA-79-02; duplicate status QA-79-06 |
+| AC-05 exact displayed download | Activation-time version remains pinned through error/switch/retry; no render/charge | Journal sequence `001,001,002`; suggested files `result-generation-001.mp4`, `result-generation-002.mp4`; zero assembly/credit calls | Bounded identity pass; pending presentation QA-79-04; RU unknown-state overflow QA-79-03 |
+| AC-06 ready actions/scope | Native player, download and first-turn return; no share/export settings/track selector | Ready EN/RU show native controls and scoped actions. Return is in header rather than beneath player (Flow 10 §4); its actual destination was not exercised | Partial. Header placement is a minor additional contract discrepancy; include in action-group follow-up |
+| AC-07 localization/focus/responsiveness | EN/RU, phone 48px/16px labels, loaded Mabry, visible focus | Six ready captures at 1440×900, 1440×700, 390×844; RU 767/768; [Watch new focus](evidence/watch-new-focus-ru-phone.png) visible | Pass for ordinary phone sizes/focus sample; fail for localized unknown download QA-79-03; busy semantics QA-79-04 |
+| AC-08 delivery failure | Recover same generation, preserve media/takes; no new assembly/credit | Native video network-error Retry playback refreshed generation `result-state-generation-001`; zero assembly/credit calls. [Network error](evidence/playback-error-en-desktop.png) | Bounded media-error recovery pass; first descriptor request failure dead-end QA-79-01 |
+| AC-VIS-01 mapped appearance | BTN/PGR/THK-derived states, explicit adaptations, usable hierarchy | BTN fills/radius/type and 4px PGR match inspected mapping; sparse pending region, busy disabled treatment and action hierarchy need attention | Partial; findings below |
+
+Ready matrix: [EN desktop](evidence/ready-en-desktop.png), [EN short](evidence/ready-en-short.png), [EN phone](evidence/ready-en-phone.png), [RU desktop](evidence/ready-ru-desktop.png), [RU short](evidence/ready-ru-short.png), [RU phone](evidence/ready-ru-phone.png), [RU 767](evidence/ready-ru-767.png), [RU 768](evidence/ready-ru-768.png). Ordinary states had no horizontal overflow; 767px uses 48px actions and 768px switches to 28px desktop actions. This abrupt density change follows the breakpoint contract and is not separately counted as a defect.
+
+## Findings
+
+### QA-79-01 — HIGH — First playback-access failure leaves a blank, unrecoverable result screen
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Evidence status:** confirmed in a service-error fixture. **Contract:** AC-08, AC-06; Flow 10 §7 and finished-player recovery.
+
+**Reproduce:** open the controlled Result fixture with a valid current generation; make the first `results.loadPlayback` return a non-ok service response, before any displayed generation or URL exists. The capture script's `descriptor-failure` state implements precisely this seam. The screen shows Your result, project title and Return to recording, with no error, video, Retry playback, or Download.
+
+**Expected vs actual:** a failed authorization/descriptor request should explain the delivery problem and offer same-generation recovery. Instead, `showGeneration` sets `playbackFailed` and exits, but recovery is nested inside `displayedGeneration && playbackUrl`. Those values were never set. Source: `frontend/src/features/result/ResultScreen.tsx:164–180,494,527–534`. The UI assertion confirmed zero Retry playback buttons. This is distinct from a native `<video>` network error after a descriptor exists; that separate path does expose recovery and passed the targeted check.
+
+**Impact:** a transient access/service failure strands the primary review/download job and gives no explanation. Navigation away and re-entry is the only visible escape, while the result itself remains valid.
+
+**Recommendation / next validation:** preserve the target generation and render the playback-access error/retry outside the successful-player subtree. Retry descriptor loading for that exact generation without assembly/credit calls. Validate first result, current result and retained previous result with non-ok/throw/expired descriptors, then successful retry and unchanged identity.
+
+![First descriptor failure: no error or retry is visible](evidence/descriptor-failure-en-desktop.png)
+
+### QA-79-02 — MEDIUM — A result shown during replacement assembly is not labeled Previous version
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Contract:** AC-03/04/06, Flow 10 §§3–5.3 and principal-stage rule.
+
+**Reproduce:** return an assembling project/active replacement operation together with valid current generation 1; open Result. Progress appears first and generation 1 remains playable underneath, but Previous version is absent. [Metrics](metrics.json), capture `replacement-en-short`, confirm both assembly and the prior video.
+
+**Cause / expected vs actual:** the prior finished result remains authoritative current while its replacement is unfinished. The label is guarded only by `displayedGeneration.id !== currentGeneration?.id` (`ResultScreen.tsx:496–498`), so equal IDs suppress the label precisely during replacement. The specification explicitly requires Previous version while replacement assembles. A generic Displayed generation: 1 below the player does not tell the owner this is the previous finished output.
+
+**Impact:** the owner can mistake the old downloadable video for the replacement currently assembling.
+
+**Recommendation / next validation:** derive the previous-result presentation from replacement operation state as well as current/displayed inequality. Retain the old media identity; do not switch early. Check pending/validating/retry/failure with a prior result in EN/RU, plus first assembly without any prior result.
+
+![Replacement assembles above an unlabeled prior player](evidence/replacement-en-short.png)
+
+### QA-79-03 — MEDIUM — Russian unknown-download recovery overflows the 390px page
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Contract:** AC-05/07, AC-VIS-01; retained 48px phone targets and localization/reflow rules.
+
+**Reproduce:** at 390×844, locale RU, start Download, then resolve the request as unknown. The main action becomes `Проверить и повторить скачивание версии 1`. The capture script's `unknown-download` seam changes only the fixture outcome. The actual Result copy/CSS remain untouched.
+
+**Measured fact:** document width becomes **405px** at a **390px** viewport. The action is **389.42px** wide starting at x=16, so its right edge is x=405.42; the video also expands from the ordinary 358px to 389.42px. The button's ending is clipped in the initial viewport. Phone height remains correctly 48px and label 16px/24px. Cause: no-wrap label plus intrinsic grid sizing lets a long recovery action dictate track width. Sources: `ResultScreen.tsx:85–86,538–563`; `frontend/src/App.css:303–317`; `ResultScreen.css:1–5,123–176`.
+
+**Impact:** the recovery action and media leave the phone gutter, and the owner needs horizontal movement to inspect the full action. This is not merely a preference for larger controls.
+
+**Recommendation / next validation:** constrain grid items to available width and allow long localized recovery labels to wrap with growing button height, or approve shorter localized copy while retaining version identity in the adjacent message. Check EN/RU unknown/error/old-version retry at 320, 390, 767 and 768px, including focus visibility and no hidden overflow.
+
+![Long Russian reconciliation action widens and clips the phone screen](evidence/unknown-download-ru-phone.png)
+
+### QA-79-04 — MEDIUM — Pending download is treated as disabled rather than readable busy work
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Contract:** AC-05/07, AC-VIS-01; design-tokens §3 busy-versus-disabled rule.
+
+**Reproduce:** start version-1 Download and hold its service response pending; publish generation 2 during active old playback. Preparing download… is disabled, `aria-busy` is absent, and computed opacity is **0.4**. Watch new is also disabled with no adjacent reason. Source: `ResultScreen.tsx:502,530,542,555`; shared `Button` already supports a focusable `busy` prop (`frontend/src/components/ui/button.tsx:31–82`), while `App.css:332–334` dims disabled controls.
+
+**Expected vs actual:** the selected adaptation explicitly requires pending controls to retain normal readable styling, expose busy/status, stay focusable and guard duplicate actions. Here real pending work is presented using unavailable-control treatment. The copy changes, but no busy state is exposed on the action. A held request also blocks the independent Watch new action, despite the verification contract calling for a version switch with an old request in flight.
+
+**Impact:** the owner cannot focus the pending action to inspect its state, the work appears unavailable, and a slow download access request blocks reviewing the newly ready video. This review does not infer a WCAG violation from size or opacity alone; the mismatch is against the project's explicit busy contract.
+
+**Recommendation / next validation:** use the existing shared busy behavior for the actual pending action, retain readable status, and scope duplicate guards to the affected operation. Allow or explicitly resolve Watch new during a pinned old-generation request. Verify keyboard focus remains stable and old request identity remains pinned even when presentation changes.
+
+![Pending download and Watch new are dimmed/disabled](evidence/new-ready-download-pending-en-short.png)
+
+### QA-79-05 — MEDIUM — Required desktop density underweights the primary download job
+
+**Class:** requirement/design flaw, with a minor action-placement implementation discrepancy noted below. **Contract lens:** AC-06/07/VIS; Flow 10 §3 media-first hierarchy and §4 actions.
+
+**Measured fact:** ready EN desktop has a **1200×612px** player and a **133.25×28px** Download MP4 control with **13px/20px** type at x=1186.75,y=797. Return to recording is another 28px action at the opposite top corner. This correctly follows the current compact desktop button requirement; it is not reported as a density implementation bug. At 1440×700, RU Download starts at **y=677** and ends at **705**, partially outside the viewport. In replacement progress it starts at **y=709**, completely below the short viewport. Browser scrolling remains possible; the action is not permanently unreachable.
+
+**Interpretation:** media should dominate, but a large review stage paired with a tiny isolated corner action makes the core “get my result” step visually weak. A 28px hit height and 13px label are unnecessarily demanding for the primary task after a long recording journey. The 68vh video cap budgets only the video, not all status/caption/action content; localized text or replacement notices push the action out of the first view. This usability critique stands even though the density matches source values. It is not a blanket minimum-size accessibility claim.
+
+**Recommendation / next validation:** preserve Mabry, palette, source radius and state treatments; consider an explicitly approved larger primary Result action (for example 36–40px with 14–16px text) and a coherent action row below the player. Budget the player against available height after statuses/actions. Flow 10 §4 also places Return beneath the player; implementation currently places it only in the header (`ResultScreen.tsx:440–449,554–565`). Resolve that minor placement discrepancy in the same bounded action-group work. Compare desktop 900/700px, EN/RU, new-ready and delivery-error states; check the player remains principal while the next action is visible and easy to acquire.
+
+Sources: `design-tokens.md:86–96` (compact density), `ResultScreen.css:39–45,123–127` (video cap/action row), `ResultScreen.tsx:440–449,554–565`.
+
+![Large ready player paired with a small corner download action](evidence/ready-en-desktop.png)
+
+![Russian ready action partly below a 700px viewport](evidence/ready-ru-short.png)
+
+### QA-79-07 — MEDIUM — First assembly collapses the principal stage into a small line
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation mismatch with a product hierarchy consequence. **Contract:** AC-02/VIS, Flow 10 §§3–4 principal stage.
+
+**Reproduce:** open the untrusted-progress Result fixture with no prior result at 1440×900. Only the heading, back action and a small Assembling video… line remain near the upper left. With trusted progress, a thin correct bar is added. There is no retained principal-stage region; the ready state later inserts a large 612px-high player. Source: `ResultScreen.tsx:466–475,494` and `ResultScreen.css:66–78`.
+
+**Expected vs actual:** the flow explicitly puts truthful initial assembly status in the principal region and keeps the stage footprint for assembly/validation/recovery, so the workspace does not jump to an unrelated composition. The implementation correctly avoids invented percentages but abandons that hierarchy entirely. This is a state-layout issue, not a request for a fabricated progress bar, ETA or decorative animation.
+
+**Impact / recommendation:** the waiting state looks like incomplete content and gives the screen's main question little visual emphasis. Establish a deliberate, stable pending region aligned with the player footprint, with a readable controlled status and optional trusted bar. Size it purposefully rather than introducing an arbitrary giant black placeholder. Validate unknown→known→ready and failure/recovery on desktop and phone, including reduced motion and short height.
+
+![Initial assembly has no principal-stage region](evidence/assembly-unknown-en-desktop.png)
+
+### QA-79-06 — LOW — Intended screen-reader announcement appears as duplicate visible content
+
+**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Contract:** AC-04/07/VIS; readable controlled status without duplicate chrome.
+
+**Reproduce:** play generation 1, publish generation 2. New version ready is already shown beside Watch new above the player. A second visible New version ready line appears below Download. The RU screenshot shows the same duplicate.
+
+**Cause / measured fact:** `ResultScreen.tsx:569` uses `className="sr-only"`, but repository CSS defines `.visually-hidden` at `App.css:583–590`; literal search found no `sr-only` definition in `frontend/src`. The announcement computes `position: static`, `clip: auto`, **358×24px** on the phone. This confirms it is visible layout content, not a screenshot artifact.
+
+**Impact / recommendation:** the repeated readiness line looks like a misplaced second status and consumes extra space below the primary action. Use the existing visually-hidden utility for the announcement while retaining accessible status semantics. Check one visible readiness message, one screen-reader announcement, no visual jump, and cleanup after Watch new.
+
+![Readiness appears twice: above the player and below Download](evidence/new-ready-ru-phone.png)
+
+## Reference map and what works
+
+Exact source pairs inspected: `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/button/Clean/button-clean.md.txt` Light tokens/geometry/states lines 289–440 and `Light/01-initial.png`; `progress-tracker/Clean/progress-tracker-clean.md.txt` lines 270–377 and `Light/01-initial.png`; `thinking-loader/Clean/thinking-loader-clean.md.txt` lines 285–415 and `Light/01-initial.png`. Matching PNGs were opened through `view_image`. The video is a product-owned derivative, not an Affect UI player component. No random design direction or font/palette replacement was introduced.
+
+| Source / adopted mapping | Fresh browser observation | Boundary |
+|---|---|---|
+| BTN medium: 28px, 13/20 Medium, radius 6; dark `.88`/on-solid `#fcfcfc`, white secondary with subtle edge shadow | Computed button height/type/radius/fills match; source personality is recognizable | Source compliance does not settle primary-action usability QA-79-05 |
+| Explicit Mabry substitution | Both 400/500 loaded; button computed Mabry Pro 500; heading 32/40 desktop and 24/32 phone | No synthetic-bold/font asset authenticity audit |
+| Phone adaptation: 48px, 16/24 | Ordinary ready/Watch new actions meet these values and visible focus is clear | Unknown-download copy breaks width, QA-79-03 |
+| PGR derivative: 4px/radius2, track black .06, opaque accent `#0060e2`; no checklist/card | Trusted 42% fixture has one 4px bar; untrusted 67% produces no displayed percentage/bar | Only supplied fixture trust semantics tested |
+| THK/plain status concept | Truthful assembly wording, no invented ETA/cancel/preparation phases | Sparse state layout QA-79-07; no timing/reduced-motion audit |
+| Product media derivative | Native play/seek/time/volume/fullscreen visible; object-fit contain; previous playing media held during generation arrival | Actual backing computes `#111` rather than token opaque black; minor source mismatch, not separately prioritized; portrait/square/fullscreen not exercised |
+| Identity-aware download/recovery | Distinct old/new fixture filenames; same old retry after switch; no assembly/credit calls; native media-error retry refreshes same generation | Fixed fixture source does not establish worker mixing, checksums, real private descriptors or retention |
